title: GRVT Burns 1.1 Million Tokens as Countdown to Grvt 2.0 Begins
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Singapore, Singapore, October 20th, 2026] The discretionary buyback represents close to 1% of circulating supply and precedes four planned product milestones culminating in Grvt 2.0.
